services.desc: Offshore Powerboat Races Spectator Cruise - Clearwater Beach! Cruise Rate Adult (Ages 13+): $91.95 Child (Ages 0-12): $58.95 Duration 8 Hours About Watch the Offshore Powerboat Races up close on the water! The luxuriously appointed StarLite Majesty Dining Yacht takes passengers through Clearwater Pass and out into the Gulf of Mexico just north of Pier 60 to view the races. Passengers will enjoy a continental breakfast during the cruise out, before the first race and a lunch buffet during the break between the first and second race. Each party will have reserved seating at shared tables. Menu Continental Breakfast: Muffins, Cinnamon Rolls, Fresh Fruit, Coffee & Tea Lunch Buffet: Caesar
